instrument.meaning: Manual verification of the frozen instrument and source corpus, NOT acceptance of phase 2.

live_index.limitation: Two consecutive equal reads, not an atomic snapshot. Full temporary capture remains a session artifact; no corpus payloads copied into this report.

semantic_dependencies.inventory_limit: Declaration/cache inventory only; not a transitive dependency resolution or proof that every declared package is needed for every opportunity.

workload_free_evaluation.meaning: Process-local workaround permits evaluation of this plain SDK project; it does not restore external metadata references.

credential_resolution_followup.meaning: After the request to continue autonomously, checked standard existing authentication mechanisms. None of the checked mechanisms is configured. This does not assert that credentials cannot exist elsewhere; unrelated secret stores were not searched.

isolated_restore_probe.project: Disposable net10.0 project in the Copilot session workspace, not in the corpus.
isolated_restore_probe.source: Only the source read from the corpus NuGet.Config; no public-feed request for private package names.
isolated_restore_probe.packages_directory: Isolated session directory, not the shared global cache.
isolated_restore_probe.meaning: Actual dotnet restore failed on authentication, independently of the unauthenticated HTTP probe. No bypass or global SDK repair attempted.

budget.accounting: Measured durations above exclude short inspection/evaluation/validation commands. The 120 s conservative charge includes those unmeasured commands and persistence; it is not claimed as an exact stopwatch measurement. Conversation time and tokens excluded. No LLM, ingestion or retrieval experiment.

harness.preexisting_failure: 5.g-declaracion-de-tipo-en-el-indice has a narrative bloqueado_por instead of a literal item ID.

reentry: Provide authenticated noninteractive access to the configured private package feed, or a complete local reference/package set for the frozen corpus. Retry restore in isolation, record actual resolved reference provenance, recheck frozen corpus/index/model hashes, then implement and measure all five arms under the remaining shared budget. Missing references must not be converted into successful abstentions or a null experiment.
preserved_worktree: Pre-existing edits to umbrella 15.2 remain outside the scope of this item; no historical results, anchors or frozen artifacts rewritten.
